basic_profile.bio: A culinary enthusiast who recently embraced the world of cast iron cooking. Originally from a small town in the Midwest, I now live in Portland, Oregon, where I work as a freelance graphic designer. I'm single and spend my evenings experimenting with new recipes or playing Pirate101. I tend to be online late at night, usually between 10 PM and 1 AM. I dislike overly complicated recipes and prefer a minimalist approach in the kitchen.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I've developed my knowledge through hands-on experience and online research. My interest in cast iron cookware started after watching a few YouTube chefs who swear by it. I've been gradually learning about seasoning, maintenance, and different brands through forums and subreddits.
